note: Generated index of Maxim experiments. Raw data + reproduction live in the pymaxim repo.

experiments.title: Cradle-mother seam
experiments.finding: Tests whether the extero/intero perceptual seam makes the embodied cradle_mother infant orient; the taught arm reaches 0.875 directedness versus 0.448 for control, lifting the instrument off its previous chance-level baseline.

experiments.title: Orient magnitude: replication + cross-session transfer
experiments.finding: On live Reachy Mini, the substrate-primary magnitude policy replicates at 0.75-1.00 (mode 0.75) across seeds and transfers to a fresh hardware session without degradation.

experiments.title: Habituation: a novel sound in a wall of noise
experiments.finding: A habituating agent reliably detects a novel sound amid 40 competing background noises while non-habituating controls perform at chance, showing familiarity-based noise suppression is essential for salience detection.

experiments.title: Operant orient: a mother teaches, a creche pools
experiments.finding: A hungry infant with no intrinsic orienting drive learns to turn toward sound purely through operant conditioning by a feeding mother, and twelve sample-limited infants federate their policies into one full-experience policy.

experiments.title: Orient magnitude: derived bin boundary
experiments.finding: The 45b ceiling was representational, not motivational: a derived bin boundary that fixed the state representation took magnitude from 0.75 to 1.00.

experiments.title: Orient magnitude: how far, not just which way
experiments.finding: The substrate learned to size rotation actions to target distance and not to overshoot, hitting the pre-registered magnitude score of 0.75 from relief-based credit alone with no LLM, effort cost, or new mechanism.

experiments.title: Substrate-native orienting, live on hardware
experiments.finding: All three pre-registered arms passed: the substrate learned a real-hardware closed-loop orientation policy from zero in ~10 trials, persisted it across sessions, and merged learners; a head-frame bug affected magnitude estimates but not directional learning.

experiments.title: Operant gaze + substrate generalization
experiments.finding: Sim feasibility study for Maxim's first job: a dict lookup hits chance (-0.005) on unseen individuals while the EntorhinalCortex substrate reaches 0.938 transfer accuracy, so the substrate's decisive advantage is visual-category generalization to novel instances.

experiments.title: Substrate-primary exploration: override its own prior?
experiments.finding: VOID: the mechanism-not-ready gate fired because the harmful action was never a high-rate temptation, making the pre-registered exploration on/off contrast uninterpretable; a follow-up (Exp 42) is recommended using terminal preference instead of harm rate.

experiments.title: Counter-prior in the Goldilocks zone (Qwen-32B)
experiments.finding: Even in the one model where substrate effects were previously detected, the agent carrying cross-session burn memory warmed at the hearth as readily as a fresh agent, showing prior-dominance holds and substrate effects depend on task-prior alignment rather than model scale.

experiments.title: Cross-model results
experiments.finding: Substrate-transfer is detectable only in a Goldilocks zone with headroom: Qwen2.5-32B shows the clearest signal (+1.43 SD) and reasoning-trained DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B amplifies it to +2.11 SD with a clean Wire-A ablation attribution.

experiments.title: Counter-prior substrate
experiments.finding: Across four frontier models, agents carrying cross-session pain from a deceptive hearth kept the wrong fire->warm prior and continued engaging the harmful entity, showing substrate state transfer does not override deeply embedded LLM priors.

experiments.title: Cross-session graduation (1.0 gate)
experiments.finding: The primary 1.0 gate: measures cross-session behavioral delta via the cradle plus the Exp 37 harness; pre-registered and in flight.

experiments.title: Roy-5b confound isolation
experiments.finding: Isolates the confound behind Roy-5b: the EC drift fix is the dominant cause and the scaffold contribution is zero.
